opening.argument: The offer presents a chance to receive Amazon gift cards in exchange for ordinary viewing and engagement actions. The description promises “10 Ten Dollar Gift Cards and one luck person will win a 100 dollar free amazon gift card,” while the speaker asks viewers to comment that they came from this video, follow the other video's instructions, and like the video. The promotion also includes a subscriber condition, requiring the creator to reach 10,000 subscribers before January. These are stated as participation requirements for a possible reward, not a request for payment or private data. The material does not establish whether any prize was ultimately awarded, but it supports an ordinary rewards and loyalty promotion.
